Rally ID: 81(c). Roman coin: A complete struck / hammered copper alloy nummus, of Constantine I (306 -337 AD), of reverse type SOL INVICTO COMITI, minted between 307 and 318 AD. Obverse: Head facing right. Obverse inscription: [ ] STANTI [ ]. Reverse: Sol standing facing with whip and globe. O to left of Sol. Reverse inscription: [ ] LI [ ]. Diameter: 18.71mm.
